hypotheses.A0_attention_jacobian_passes_small_finit: The full analytic tangent predicts its 0.1%-norm finite edit with median Fisher fidelity at least 0.99 on both corpora.
hypotheses.A1_full_tensor_recovers_oracle_direction: Full-tensor median oracle-effect Fisher fidelity is at least 0.90 on both corpora.
hypotheses.A2_full_tensor_recovers_oracle_magnitude: Its exact 5%-norm KL is at least 90% of the per-example oracle on both corpora.
hypotheses.A3_full_tensor_recovers_oracle_objective: Its held-out oracle-objective efficiency is at least 0.90 on both corpora.
hypotheses.A4_attention_derivatives_close_ood_gap: On WikiText, full-tensor oracle fidelity exceeds direct-tensor by at least 0.20.
hypotheses.A5_full_tangent_predicts_five_percent_ed: The full analytic tangent predicts its own 5%-norm finite edit with median Fisher fidelity at least 0.85 on both corpora.
hypotheses.A6_full_tensor_ood_stability: Full-tensor oracle fidelity drops by at most 0.10 from FineWeb to WikiText.
hypotheses.A7_full_tensor_recovers_support: Full-tensor recovers at least 50% of per-example oracle support on both corpora.
